answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the ivory is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The tundra holds work receipts rather than names, so the bridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
